Using the vectors' own copy constructors lets libstdc++ take its optimized bulk-copy path (and memcpy for the trivially copyable byte vector) instead of the generic iterator-range instantiation, with no change in behaviour.

```cpp
FieldBase::FieldBase(const FieldBase &field)
    : values(field.values),
      stringIndexes(field.stringIndexes)
{
}
```
